occurrences.snippet: Between Ṛṣabha and Madhyama two Gāndhāras are to be devised; between the other Ṣaḍja and Madhyama, komal Dhaivata.
That is, between the Ṛṣabha and Madhyama notes make the marks for two Gāndhāras at equal distance. And between tāra Sa and the Madhyama note make the mark for komal Dhaivata.
That is, between komal Dhaivata and Madhyama understand the places of two notes at equal distance: the first will be tīvra (sharp) Madhyama and the second the Pañcama note.
That is, between komal Dhaivata and tāra Ṣaḍja the wise should make three equal parts and place, in order, Dhaivata and the two Niṣādas.
That is, between Ṛṣabha and madhya Sa is the place of komal Ṛṣabha. In this way place all twelve notes in the form of marks.
